title: Xerca's Kitchen
description: Immersive food and drink from various cuisines, some with special mechanics
body:
This is a food mod that adds:

  • Japanese Cuisine such as sushi and donburimono (rice bowls)
  • Turkish Cuisine such as kebabs and sütlaç (rice pudding)
  • Cheese and yoghurt
  • Pizza with custom toppings
  • Fast food such as burgers and hotdogs
  • Sweets such as pies and cupcakes
  • Tea!
  • Soft drinks, beer, sake, ayran...
  • And more...

Seeds for the crops in this mod drop randomly from grass, the same way wheat seeds drop.

Tea

  • Harvest, dry the leaves and brew them in a teapot. 
  • You can add sugar according to your taste and to satiate some hunger.
  • Drinking tea gives a Haste effect thanks to caffeine!
  • Teapots can be placed, and the amount of steam from the pout indicates how much tea is in it.

Turkish Cuisine

Ever wanted to become a Döner cook?

Döner is made by stacking mutton on an iron bar and rotating it next to a fire or campfire. The fire may be positioned to the side, underneath, or diagonally below and to the side.

Turkish cuisine includes kebabs, as well as fish sandwich, ayran, and baked rice pudding.

Cheese and Pizza

You age cheese in traditional copper vats to make cheese, then slice with a knife or eat directly!

Made from a pizza base with cheese and tomatoes, you can combine a variety of ingredients to your heart's content. There are 56 unique pizza recipes in total!

Japanese Cuisine

This includes sushi, donburi, and comfort food like omurice and riceball! Japanese sake has a higher chance of making you drunk compared to beer.

Drinks

Besides the Tea, Ayran and Sake, there are various juices, basics like milk and water, and fizzy drinks, including beer.

Fizzy drinks are bubbly, and drinks that have caffeine give the Haste effect!

You harvest sparkling water from bubble columns. It is the source of all fizz.

 

Cola, with its secret formula, is hard to make, but fit for batch production.

Fast Food

Fast food includes burgers, sandwich types, wraps, and of course, potato fries!

Ultimate Burger is a chunky boi assembled from a separately crafted top and bottom, and it will give you a long saturation effect in addition to filling your hunger bar to the max.

Sweets and Baked Goods

There are a great many cupcake variants, and some can be decorated with Sprinkles! Be careful when eating a chorus cupcake...

Legends say there is a secret cupcake recipe, hidden in the annals of history, but who knows...

Apple pie and sweet berry pie are eaten slice by slice, like the vanilla cake.

Other

You can throw tomatoes for a satisfying splat...

 

Eggs being uncookable has to be one of the biggest crimes in Minecraft. Good thing this mod is here to fix it.

 

Eating a Glow Squid Ink Paella makes you glow like the squid.

 

Note

In older versions, this mod used to be a part of XercaMod before it was split.
